G2 PASS.

acceptance.observed: Both operator directories and all 9 corpus families are represented by end-to-end reads (kernel + case layer). Smallest: suite/dev/any_kernel_2.py (55 lines, masked load + bool reduce to scalar). Largest: suite/dev/fht_kernel_256_4row_native.py (746 lines, reshape/permute/split/join butterfly pipeline, 4-row ILP). Per-family representatives read end to end: elementwise_reduce any_kernel_2/geglu_tanh_triton/alpha_dropout_inplace, matmul matmul_k32_splitn4_paired_kernel + grouped_gemm_kernel (pointer tables), norm fused_layernorm_triton (autotune), attention flash_decode (online softmax), linear_attention fused_recurrent_hgrn_fwd_kernel (varlen, loop-carried state), select_scan_index argmax_kernel_inner (return_indices tie-break, dtype predicates), softmax_xent log_softmax_linear, conv_pool deconv3d_leaky_pool (nested dynamic loops, atomic max), quant quant_transpose_kernel (autotune, int8) + position_quantize (quantized_interval comparator). Also inspected: atomic_bitmap (all 6 atomic ops + debug_barrier), diag_scale_kernel (make_block_ptr/advance/boundary_check), ranked_distribution_semantic (tl.sort/topk), blocked_jacobi_rank_kernel (while loop).
